Ivy (People Ops): Hi — quick Q: starting parental leave in July, planning a 6-week phased return after. I need two short "drop-in" blocks per week for childcare emergencies (1-2 hours). Are those covered as intermittent leave or should I use PTO?
Marco (Engineering): We approved that for someone on my team last year. Put "intermittent" in the phased-return form and note the weekly emergency windows. Manager + people-ops approval needed.
Ivy (People Ops): Great. How does payroll treat the hours?
Jen (Payroll): Intermittent parental leave is unpaid by default. You can elect company top-up within 30 days of your leave start to cover some or all of those hours. If you prefer PTO, it will deduct from your balance.
Ivy (People Ops): Where to upload docs?
LeaveBot: Upload birth/adoption/medical docs here: https://hr.redwood-inference/internal/leave -> Parental / Intermittent. Allowed: .pdf .jpg .png. Confirmation sent within 24h.
Ivy (People Ops): Also need a loaner webcam for home days. How long can we request it for?
IT Support: Submit equipment loan with start/end dates. Typical loaners are 3 months by default; exceptions possible with manager signoff.
Marco (Engineering): I can swap pair sessions and cover weekly sync for the first 3 weeks. Add that to your handover doc.
Ivy (People Ops): Thanks — Ill submit the phased-return form today and post the handover here. If anyone else wants the emergency-window template, say so and Ill share it. :heart:
